item.title: Bring Your Laptop
item.description: Links GitHub repo Description Bring Your Laptop is a progressive web app for finding work-friendly cafes. It shows cafes on an interactive map with information about wifi, power outlets, noise level, and seating sourced from crowd-sourced user reports. Cafe locations are imported from OpenStreetMap. Users can log in via Google or Apple OAuth and submit reports rating various aspects of a cafe’s suitability for working. Reports are aggregated using vote-weighted mode to determine whether a cafe is work-friendly, and markers on the map are color-coded accordingly.
